text: dsh-matrix-theme 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的《黑客帝国》风格主题插件。它向主题服务注册绿色黑色配色，并在通用设置中加入主题开关、雨幕透明度滑块和数字雨效果等级选项；背景动画可在支持的背景插槽中渲染，也提供旧版界面的 DOM 画布回退。数字雨可选完整、轻量或关闭，尊重减少动态效果设置。适合希望自定义 DSH 网页界面外观并调整动画性能的用户；无需 API 密钥或外部服务，偏好保存在浏览器本地。

dsh-matrix-theme gives the DSH web client a Matrix palette and digital-rain backdrop. Users can toggle the theme, adjust rain opacity, and choose Full, Lite, or Off effects in General settings. It needs no API key or external service.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成绿色黑底的黑客帝国风格。
DSH 有没有数字雨动态背景主题？
让 DSH 的外观变成黑底荧光绿配色。
电脑跑动画有点卡，能不能把界面特效调轻或关掉？
我想调整聊天背景上数字雨的透明度。
DSH 网页版能加一个可切换的自定义主题吗？
Can I give the DSH web interface a green-on-black Matrix style?
I want an animated digital rain backdrop for my DSH workspace.
dsh-matrix-theme 的功能「矩阵配色」：注册绿色黑底的深色主题，覆盖界面配色别名。用户在通用设置中开启或关闭主题，关闭时恢复此前选用的主题。
dsh-matrix-theme 的功能「数字雨背景」：启用主题时在界面背景绘制动画雨幕，并叠加可调透明度的遮罩；支持背景插槽的客户端通过插槽显示。
dsh-matrix-theme 的功能「雨幕效果等级」：通用设置提供 Full、Lite、Off 三档；用户可降低绘制负担或关闭动画，选项会保存到浏览器本地。

dsh-matrix-theme README · dsh-matrix-theme：The Matrix movie theme for the [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web GUI as an installable plugin: the selectable `matrix` theme (green-on-black palette over the dark base), a digital-rain ambient backdrop (a faithful port of the [zengrz.github.io](https://github.com/zengrz/zengrz.github.io) glyph wall), its General-settings toggle row, and a rain-quality row that trades backdrop effects for performance on slower machines. One package carries both roles: the `dsh.bundle` patch layer (`cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `ui-matrix-theme` browser roster row) and the `dsh.client` plugin itself (`lib/client.js`, prebuilt and committed — no build step runs at install time).

dsh-matrix-theme README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zengrz/dsh-matrix-theme
```

Pin a commit so a later push cannot silently change what runs:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:zengrz/dsh-matrix-theme#<sha>
```

No build permission (`allowBuilds`) is needed: the published entry points are committed, and the package has no `prepare` script.

dsh-matrix-theme README · Requirements and compatibility：- On a harness that declares the `shell.backdrop` slot (ui-layout from the dsh release that introduced the ambient backdrop slot), the rain renders inside the frame's backdrop layer — below every column, click-through, and managed by the slot system.
- On a harness that **predates** the `shell.backdrop` slot (e.g. dsh `0.1.0-rc.8`), the plugin detects the missing slot at boot and falls back to a fixed-position DOM canvas behind the app root, driving the same `RainEngine`. The palette and the General-settings toggle work identically on both paths; only the backdrop's mount site differs. The fallback retires itself if the slot is later declared (e.g. a harness upgrade mid-session via HMR).
- The patch **appends and does not dedupe**: adding this plugin to a profile whose layers already register `ui-matrix-theme` — the stock `dsh-web-app` bundle ships the theme in-box from the same release — fails the load with `duplicate loader entry id: ui-matrix-theme`. Such profiles already have the theme; this plugin targets custom browser-surface rosters and web-app versions that predate the theme.
- The browser half resolves its platform
dsh-matrix-theme README · Rain quality：The General section gains a **Rain effects** row (below the Matrix theme row, visible while the matrix theme is active) with three levels:

dsh-matrix-theme README · Rain quality：- **Full** — the faithful reference effect: full-density glyph wall, per-glyph churn, cursor spotlight, and the 3D tilt.
- **Lite** — for older or integrated-GPU machines: the column/row grid draws at half density (a quarter of the per-frame glyph draws), glyph churn and the cursor spotlight are dropped, and columns faded to near-invisible depth are culled entirely. The cheap signature effects (the 3D tilt and the marching white cell) stay.
- **Off** — no canvas at all: the green palette stays, the rain costs nothing (same skip as `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`).

dsh-matrix-theme README · Rain quality：The level is a plugin-owned browser preference persisted to `localStorage` under `dsh-matrix-theme:rain-quality`; storage failures only disable persistence. Changing the level while the rain runs replaces the engine (the grid rebuilds at the new density).

dsh-matrix-theme README · Model Experience：None: the theme manages browser-side preferences (theme selection and rain quality) and the backdrop is decorative (`aria-hidden`); nothing reaches a model request.

dsh-matrix-theme README · Rebuilding the artifacts：`lib/` is committed. To regenerate it after editing `src/`, build inside a [deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) checkout (the client bundle's loader-handoff id must match this package name). Create a machine-local `build.tsdown.config.ts` (gitignored):

```ts
import { clientBundle } from '<harness>/packages/client/tsdown.client.ts'
export default clientBundle('dsh-matrix-theme', ['src/index.ts'])
```

then run:

dsh-matrix-theme README · Rebuilding the artifacts：```sh
cd <this-repo>
ln -sfn <harness>/packages/client/ui-matrix-theme/node_modules node_modules
<harness>/node_modules/.bin/tsdown --config build.tsdown.config.ts
```
dsh-matrix-theme README · License：[MIT](LICENSE), matching the dsh family. The theme engine is a port of the MIT-licensed [zengrz.github.io](https://github.com/zengrz/zengrz.github.io) effect.
